This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 神农和他的家人住在古代：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 因为他的家人常常生病了：常常生病，no了for routine/habit
- 他们去很多不一样的地方：去了，了completed

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住在古代：在古代，神农和他的家人住在一起，古代 is a time expression, not a place where someone can live; use 在古代 to set the time.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 常常生病了：常常生病，常常 marks a habitual action or state, so it takes the zero aspect particle rather than completed-action 了.
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的男人，this is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a fuller noun phrase before using his name in the story.
4. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他们去很多不一样的地方：他们去了很多不一样的地方，use 了 after 去 to mark the completed narrative action of visiting many places.

items.reason: “住在古代” can correctly mean living in ancient times; the proposed rewrite is grammatical but unnecessarily changes the wording and emphasis.
常常 describes a habitual situation, so 生病 should not take completed-action 了.
As this is the character’s first appearance, the teacher requires a fuller introduction before using 神农 as the story referent.
The trip to many places is a completed narrative event, so 去 needs 了.
